mapper.sql: SELECT ics40_dcr_preconfirm_id AS dcr_preconfirm_id, ics40_reg_date AS reg_date, ics40_dcr_type_cd AS dcr_type_code, ics41_dcr_type_nm AS dcr_type_name, (CASE WHEN ics40_appr_no_prefix IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ics40_appr_no_prefix END) AS appr_no, ics40_appr_no_prefix AS appr_no_prefix, ics40_provide_co AS provide_co, ics40_content AS content, (f_emp_kor_nm(ics40_person_id) || '(' || f_get_emptrans(ics40_person_id, ics40_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm') || ')') AS person_name, ics40_appr_id AS appr_id, f_emp_kor_nm(ics40_confirmer_id) AS confirmer_name, ics40_confirm_date AS confirm_date, ics40_status_cd AS status_code, f_cdnm('StatusCode', ics40_status_cd, ics40_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS status_name, ics40_confirm_msg AS confirm_msg, ics40_reg_emp_msg AS reg_emp_msg, (CASE WHEN ics40_confirm_msg IS NOT NULL THEN '있음' WHEN ics40_reg_emp_msg IS NOT NULL THEN '있음' ELSE '' END) AS msg_yn_str, f_cdnm('AdType', ics40_ad_type, ics40_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS ad_type_name, f_cdnm('MediaType', ics40_media_type, ics40_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS media_type_name, ics40_ad_item_nm AS ad_item_name, ics40_ad_content AS ad_content, ics40_start_date AS start_date, ics40_close_date AS close_date, ics40_spec AS spec, ics40_qty_cnt AS qty_cnt, ics40_pre_appr_no AS pre_appr_no FROM ics40_dcr_preconfirm INNER JOIN ics41_dcr_type ON (ics41_company_id = ics40_company_id AND ics41_dcr_type_cd = ics40_dcr_type_cd)
mapper.update: UPDATE ics40_dcr_preconfirm SET ics40_appr_no_prefix = (SELECT #{year} || '-' || #{dcrTypeCode} || LPAD(CAST(MAX(COALESCE(ics40_appr_no_seq, 0)) + 1 AS TEXT), 3, '0') FROM ics40_dcr_preconfirm WHERE ics40_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics40_dcr_type_cd = #{dcrTypeCode}), ics40_appr_no_seq = (SELECT MAX(COALESCE(ics40_appr_no_seq, 0)) + 1 FROM ics40_dcr_preconfirm WHERE ics40_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics40_dcr_type_cd = #{dcrTypeCode}), ics40_status_cd = #{statusCode}, ics40_confirmer_id = #{confirmerId}, ics40_confirm_date = f_sysdate() WHERE ics40_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics40_dcr_preconfirm_id = #{dcrPreconfirmId}

UPDATE ics40_dcr_preconfirm SET ics40_appr_no_prefix = null, ics40_appr_no_seq = null, ics40_status_cd = #{statusCode}, ics40_confirmer_id = null, ics40_confirm_date = null WHERE ics40_company_id = #{companyId} AND ics40_dcr_preconfirm_id = #{dcrPreconfirmId}
mapper.sql: SELECT ics41_dcr_type_id AS dcr_type_id, ics41_dcr_type_cd AS dcr_type_code, ics41_dcr_type_nm AS dcr_type_name, COALESCE(ics41_ad_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS ad_yn, COALESCE(ics41_use_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS use_yn FROM ics41_dcr_type
mapper.select: SELECT ics41_dcr_type_cd AS code, ics41_dcr_type_nm AS name FROM ics41_dcr_type WHERE ics41_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(ics41_use_yn, 'false') = 'true' ORDER BY ics41_dcr_type_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ics41_dcr_type (ics41_dcr_type_id, ics41_company_id, ics41_dcr_type_cd, ics41_dcr_type_nm, ics41_ad_yn, ics41_use_yn) VALUES (#{req.dcrTypeId}, #{companyId}, #{req.dcrTypeCode}, #{req.dcrTypeName}, CAST(#{req.adYn} AS TEXT), CAST(#{req.useYn} AS TEXT))
mapper.update: UPDATE ics41_dcr_type SET ics41_dcr_type_cd = #{req.dcrTypeCode}, ics41_dcr_type_nm = #{req.dcrTypeName}, ics41_ad_yn = CAST(#{req.adYn} AS TEXT), ics41_use_yn = CAST(#{req.useYn} AS TEXT) WHERE ics41_dcr_type_id = #{req.dcrTypeId} AND ics41_company_id = #{companyId}
